notablePrerequisites:
Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry by tapping it.
When Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
